title: One dashboard, two names
line: API Portal and API Console name the same dashboard. Both link to the same console, and no page uses both.

title: "Disabled" does too many jobs
line: Used for settings, accounts and buttons. On the firewall page it describes two toggles with opposite results.

title: Sonar outlived its retirement
line: Sonar support ended in September 2026, but the Audit API pages still say "Sonar API keys".

title: Two spellings of one menu path
line: "Organization Settings" and "Organization settings" both appear, and three pages use both.

title: Spaces are still here
line: Spaces became Projects, but the Comet data deletion article still says Spaces.

title: Session or thread?
line: Help calls a saved conversation a session. The Computer docs call it a thread, and the help article's URL still says thread.

title: Four names for the admin role
line: Help says organization admin, Enterprise admin and organization administrator. The docs mostly say org admin. The roles page says Admin.

title: API Group or Project?
line: One cookbook page says API Group and API Group administrator. Other docs pages say Project and Project administrator.

title: Two names for the audit key
line: Docs say "audit log API key". Help says "Audit API key". Each has its own heading about creating one.

title: Sidecar or Assistant panel?
line: Help uses both in one sentence: "Send to sidecar to continue the conversation in your Assistant panel."

title: One credit setting, four names
line: Adding credits when the balance runs low is Auto reload, auto top-up, Automatic Top Up or auto_recharge, depending on the page.

title: Free plan or Standard?
line: The pricing page calls it Free. Two help articles add Standard, as in "What do I get with the Free (Standard) plan?"

title: A toggle that isn't there
line: One help article says Pro Search is automatic, with "nothing to turn on". Another says "turn on Pro Search".
